coreMemory.english: v. to accept that something is true；v. to have an opinion or think that something is true；v. to have confidence or faith in a person, idea, or ability
coreMemory.structure: believe someone or something /bɪˈliːv ˈsʌˌmwʌn ˈɔːr ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（相信某人或某事）；believe that + clause /bɪˈliːv ˈðæt ˈklɔːz/（相信或认为……）；believe in someone or something /bɪˈliːv ɪn ˈsʌˌmwʌn ˈɔːr ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（信任某人；信仰或相信某种价值）；be believed to be /ˈbiː bɪˈliːvd ˈtuː ˈbiː/（被认为是……）

structures.chinese: 信任某人；信仰或相信某种价值

coreMemory.commonError: ❌ believe to him → ✅ believe him；❌ believe on yourself → ✅ believe in yourself；❌ I am believe this → ✅ I believe this

commonErrors.note: believe 表示“相信某人所说的话”时直接接人，不加 to。
表示“相信某人的能力或价值”用 believe in。
believe 是动词，不能放在 am 后作表语。

coreMemory.directSynonym: trust /ˈtrʌst/（信任；相信）；think /ˈθɪŋk/（认为；觉得）；accept /æˈksɛpt/（接受；相信）；be convinced /ˈbiː kəˈnvɪnst/（确信）
coreMemory.example: I believe this plan can work.

meanings.english: to accept that something is true
meanings.example: I believe what she told me.

meanings.english: to have an opinion or think that something is true
meanings.example: I believe this is the best option.
meanings.translation: 我认为这是最好的选择。

meanings.english: to have confidence or faith in a person, idea, or ability
meanings.example: You need to believe in yourself.

fixedPhrases.example: I believe you, and I am here to help.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我相信你，也会在这里帮助你。

fixedPhrases.example: I believe that small habits can make a big difference.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我相信小习惯能带来大改变。

fixedPhrases.example: You have prepared well, so believe in yourself.
fixedPhrases.translation: 你准备得很好，所以要相信自己。

fixedPhrases.example: We have reason to believe the data are accurate.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我们有理由相信这些数据是准确的。

fixedPhrases.example: The painting is believed to be over two hundred years old.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这幅画被认为有两百多年历史。

fixedPhrases.example: “Will she join us?” “I believe so.”
fixedPhrases.translation: “她会加入我们吗？”“我想会的。”

fixedPhrases.example: Believe it or not, I finished the book in one day.
fixedPhrases.translation: 信不信由你，我一天就读完了那本书。

fixedPhrases.example: I could not believe my eyes when I saw the result.
fixedPhrases.translation: 看到结果时，我简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。

synonyms.difference: 多指相信某人的诚实、能力或可靠性；believe someone 更侧重相信对方所说的话。
表达普通意见，语气往往比 believe 弱，也不表示信仰。
表示在考虑证据后承认某事为真，也可表示接受提议或物品。
强调经过证据或说服后非常确定，确信程度通常比 believe 高。

antonyms.usage: 最常见的反向表达，表示不确定某事是否真实或是否会发生。
表示认定某个说法不真实，比 doubt 更明确。
用于拒绝观点、说法或证据，不只是对真实性存疑。

derivatives.note: 非常常用；注意 believe 结尾是 -ve，belief 结尾是 -f。
表示故事、解释或人物看起来可能是真的。
既可表示“不可信”，口语中也常表示“惊人地好”。
常见结构 a firm believer in，表示“……的坚定信奉者”。

confusables.difference: belief 是名词；believe 是动词。注意拼写变化：believe → belief。
trust someone 常指相信其可靠性；believe someone 常指相信其所说的话。
belong 与 believe 开头相近，但含义和搭配完全不同；belong 通常与 to 连用。

examples.english: I believe you, even though the story sounds unusual.
examples.chinese: 虽然这件事听起来不寻常，但我相信你。

examples.english: I believe this is the safest option.
examples.chinese: 我认为这是最安全的选择。

examples.english: Do you believe everything you read online?
examples.chinese: 你相信网上读到的所有内容吗？

examples.english: You need to believe in yourself.
examples.chinese: 你需要相信自己。

examples.english: She believes in treating everyone with respect.
examples.chinese: 她信奉尊重每一个人。

examples.english: We have reason to believe the problem has been fixed.
examples.chinese: 我们有理由相信问题已经修复。

examples.english: The building is believed to be unsafe.
examples.chinese: 这栋建筑被认为不安全。

examples.english: It is hard to believe how quickly the year passed.
examples.chinese: 很难相信这一年过得这么快。

examples.english: “Will the plan work?” “I believe so.”
examples.chinese: “这个计划会奏效吗？”“我想会的。”

examples.english: I could not believe my eyes when I saw the final score.
examples.chinese: 看到最终分数时，我简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。

studyFocus.coreMeaning: believe 可表示相信事实、表达观点，也可用 believe in 表示信任某人的能力或信奉某种理念。
studyFocus.keyCollocation: 重点掌握 believe someone、believe that 和 believe in。
studyFocus.commonMistake: 相信某人所说的话直接说 believe someone，不加 to。
studyFocus.mustUseExample: I believe that small habits can make a big difference.
